proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.spell_option_restriction
proposed_widenings.justification: A granted spell can be available only with a narrowed subset of its internal cast-time options. The current surface can grant a spell but cannot restrict which command word choices are legal.

proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.spell_header_override
proposed_widenings.justification: A granted spell can have an item-specific area/range header that differs from the base authored spell. The current surface only supports DC and target restrictions, not area/range overrides.

notes: The item otherwise fits the existing magic-item activation surface: holding-item gate, charge pool, dawn recharge, fixed DC override, and last-charge destruction. I stopped before authoring content because encoding unrestricted Command or base Fear would misrepresent the item.
